job.organization: Los Angeles County Office of Education

items.item_text: 01. Listed below are a series of questions regarding your education and experience relating to the position. You must answer the following questionnaire as truthfully and accurately as possible. Your responses to the supplemental questionnaire below may be used in subsequent examination parts to determine your qualifications beyond the minimum qualification requirements for this classification. A few questions will require you to provide examples of related experience, and listing "see resume/application" will NOT qualify as a response and will be considered incomplete, so make sure to answer each question thoroughly. All experience, education, training, and certification must be included in your application in order to be considered. Your responses to these questions are subject to verification and may be assessed in subsequent examination parts. It is important that your responses are true and accurate reflections of your background. Any sign of deliberate misinformation or intentional exaggeration will result in disqualification from this examination process and possible bar from future employment opportunities with the Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE). Options: I have read, understood, and agree to the above statements | I have read, understood, and DO NOT agree with the above statements. In selecting this, I voluntarily withdraw from the application process for this position

02. Are you currently a permanent employee or a laid-off former permanent employee within 39 months from the date of reduction in force (RIF) at Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE)? This opportunity is promotional-only and reserved for individuals who meet one of the two criteria above. Options: Yes | No

03. The incumbent of this position may require the possession of a valid driver's license or the ability to obtain transportation between job sites. Are you willing and able to comply with this requirement? Options: Yes | No

04. What is your highest level of education? Please Note: Proof of education will be required - you must attach a copy of your diploma or transcript for review. Degrees must be earned from an institution of higher learning recognized by the Council for Higher Education. Foreign degrees and credit units require translation and equivalency established by an agency recognized by the Commission on Teacher Credentialing. Options: No education | High School Diploma or GED equivalent | Some college coursework but no degree | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate Degree

05. How many years of experience do you have in managing business, fiscal, administrative, and program operations (e.g., budget administration, grants and contracts, compliance, personnel/workforce operations, and organizational systems) in an educational setting ? Options: No Experience | Less than one year of experience | At least one year, but less than two years | At least two years, but less than three years | At least three years, but less than four years | At least four years, but less than five years | Five years or more

06. Regarding your selection for Question 5, please describe your experience in managing business operations in an educational setting. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

07. Regarding your selection for Question 5, please describe your experience in managing fiscal operations in an educational setting. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

08. Regarding your selection for Question 5, please describe your experience in managing administrative operations in an educational setting. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

09. Regarding your selection for Question 5, please describe your experience in managing program operations in an educational setting. For each related experience, please include: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Length(s) of employment If no experience in this area, list "N/A".

10. Briefly summarize your experience managing the following in an education setting: a) Budget administration b) Grants and contracts c) Compliance d) Personnel/workforce operations e) Organizational systems If no experience in these areas, list "N/A"

11. Regarding your experience with managing business, fiscal, administrative, and program operations in an educational setting, how many years of experience were in a supervisory capacity? [Supervisory experience includes responsibilities in assigning, scheduling, and monitoring the work of a group. This role has responsibility to hire, evaluate performance, administer disciplinary action, and approving payroll or paid time off.] Options: I do not have any supervisory experience | Less than one year of experience | At least one year, but less than two years | At least two years, but less than three years | Three years or more

12. Regarding the selection you made in the previous question about your supervisory experience, provide the following details for EACH related role: a) Your job title(s) b) Name of the organization(s) c) Supervisory job duties/responsibilities related to the job areas described above d) Number of direct and indirect reports e) Job titles of employees supervised f) Length(s) of employment as a supervisor If no experience in this area, list "N/A".
